verdict.rationale: The Department's own pages offer some plain-language procedural guidance. It recommends registering through the online Florida Business Tax Application, says what screen appears before submitting Form RT-6, explains how to reverse an E-Verify certification by email, and publishes a guide on logging into the new system. None of this is shown to be step-by-step task guidance written for a founder; most evidence describes system features and technical specs. Missing for 10: documented end-to-end step-by-step explainers for founder tasks such as registering a business or collecting sales tax, evidence that guidance is written for non-lawyers rather than as form references, and independent or hands-on corroboration of usability.

support.subject: As a founder, the service publishes plain-language, step-by-step guidance for my task — explainers a non-lawyer can follow, not just statute text and form numbers

citations.quote: The Department recommends that employers register to pay reemployment tax using the online Florida Business Tax Application
This publication provides information on how to log into the new system, retrieve a forgotten user ID and password, and available resources.
If you would like to reverse your certification status for the current or previous calendar year, email your request to rt_decertify@floridarevenue.com
A screen with the electronic certification statement will appear prior to submission of the Employer's Quarterly Report (Form RT-6)
